name: Keeper Thistle
dialogue: Follow the frost-blue pipes northeast from Warmhearth to Keeper Thistle.

Wake both lake pumps, then turn the central regulator. The stone crossing between the two lakes is always safe. Entrance requires the Rimeglass Valve Key. Search the Frozen Courier Cache east of Badger’s Lantern in Stonecrest. Defeat its three sentries, then recover the valve key. Defeat the guardian, recover its expedition seal, then return to Keeper Thistle. REWARD: Winter’s Whisper — freeze foes with precise shots — plus Frost Breath, a sweeping cone of biting cold.

name: Foreman Brindle
dialogue: Follow the silent furnace chimneys east of Ember Rest to Foreman Brindle.

Turn one valve in each side wing to cool the furnace bridge. Either wing can be visited first; the bridge stays open. Entrance requires the Cindercoil Foundry Key. Search the Smuggler’s Tool Chest east of Reedlight Refuge in Reedwater. Defeat its three guards, then recover the foundry key. Defeat the guardian, recover its expedition seal, then return to Foreman Brindle. REWARD: Ember Bastion Armor — taking a hit awakens a brief protective bulwark.

name: Pilgrim Sora
dialogue: Follow the wind bells northeast of Reedlight Refuge to Pilgrim Sora.

Ring the three terrace bells in any order, then awaken the sanctuary in the middle of the loop. Defeat the guardian, recover its expedition seal, then return to Pilgrim Sora. REWARD: Galeweave Mantle — reload for speed and an empowered shot — plus Aurora Well, a healing sanctuary.

name: Diver Pearl
dialogue: Follow the shell markers east of Crownrest Haven to Diver Pearl at the Drowned Maw seaside cave.

Release the three tide anchors along the flooded piers. Beyond the gate waits Nacremaw, the Great Kraken: an optional level 26 challenge with no time limit. Defeat Nacremaw, the Great Kraken, recover its expedition seal, then return to Diver Pearl. REWARD: Legendary Sea Beast Armor — summon spectral tentacles with repeated firearm hits and leave slowing ink when you dodge.
